`old-zero.bin` is the pre-F4 EventLog wire output supplied during seqzero round 1,
retained byte-for-byte from the seqcold69 compatibility measurement. It contains
one GCounterDelta record (author 1, sequence 0, delta replica 1, tally 7) with
replica count 2. It was generated by the product encoder, not hand-assembled.
SHA-256: 783889a0a62eee07e632d43090f9c5d30bca7149692e223bb74d3389a6aa7822.
The unconditional `seqzero_two_replica_exchange_and_persisted_replay` test decodes
and replays it. EventLog wire frames contain records, not cached VersionVectors;
loading an old log reconstructs zero acknowledgments from the accepted records.
